scheme_name: National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship & Management (NIFTEM)
overview: NIFTEM (National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management) is an Institute of National Importance established under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI), Government of India, to provide a conducive ecosystem for education, research, industrial promotion, support, and entrepreneurship in the food processing sector. It offers academic programs ranging from B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, PhD, and integrated programmes, and supports innovation through incubation, skill development, and industry collaboration. NIFTEM also implements government schemes like PMFME and facilitates technology transfer and entrepreneurship development.
objectives: To act as an international center of excellence integrating all facets of food science, entrepreneurship and management
To serve as a focal point for catalyzing the growth of food processing industry in India and the world
To work as a 'One Stop Solution Provider' for all problems of the sector
To work for 'Skill Development and Entrepreneurship Development' for the sector
To conduct Frontier Area Research and foster Innovation for the development of the sector
To develop World Class Managerial Talent coupled with advanced knowledge in Food Science and Technology
To function as a Knowledge Repository
To work for the up-gradation of SME food processing clusters
To provide intellectual backing for regulations governing Food Quality and Safety
To promote cooperation and networking among existing institutions within India and Abroad
eligibility: Eligibility varies by programme: For B.Tech, candidates must have passed class 12th and qualified JEE (Main) 2021; for MBA, a Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for SC/ST) or equivalent CGPA is required; for M.Tech, a relevant Bachelor's degree with valid GATE score; for PhD, a Master's degree in relevant discipline with research proposal; for integrated programmes, eligibility is as per the respective constituent programmes.
benefits: NIFTEM provides academic excellence, industry-oriented curriculum, incubation support through NTIBIF, access to pilot plants and research facilities, industry linkages, internship and placement opportunities, scholarships and financial aid, international immersion programmes, skill development programmes, entrepreneurship development, technology transfer, consultancy services, and recognition as a Center of Excellence in Food Processing Technology by MoFPI.
financial_support: NIFTEM offers Institute fellowships for M.Tech, M.Sc, and regular PhD scholars with valid GATE/CUET scores as per MoE norms; Merit, Merit-cum-Means, and Industry Sponsored (Corporate) scholarships; educational loan assistance via SBI branch on campus; and financial support for startups and MSMEs through incubation, mentoring, and capacity-building initiatives under NTIBIF. The institute also facilitates access to government schemes like PMFME which provides financial, technical, and business support for upgradation of existing micro food processing enterprises.
application_process: 1. Visit the NIFTEM admission portal at www.niftem.ac.in 2. Check the Admission Prospectus for the relevant academic session for programme details and important dates 3. Commence online application from the specified date (e.g., 29 April 2026 for many programmes) 4. Submit the online application before the last date (e.g., 3 June 2026 for many programmes) 5. Upload required documents including academic certificates, scorecards, and identity proof 6. Pay the prescribed application fee online 7. Appear for entrance tests, GD/PI, or other selection processes as per the programme 8. Await merit list and counselling notification 9. Complete admission formalities upon selection
required_documents: Bank certificate or passbook for last six months
Balance sheet for last 3 financial years (for tender/EOI applications)
Undertaking of investment capability (for tender/EOI applications)
Chartered Accountant’s signed statement for Annual Turnover
Copies of Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account
Annexures as specified in tender/EOI documents
deadlines: Varies by programme and announcement; for example, last date for B.Tech, B.Tech+MBA, BBA (Hons) applications was extended to 3 June 2026; for MBA and Executive MBA, extended to 30 June 2026; tender/EOI deadlines are specified in individual notices (e.g., 23 July 2026 for EOI on pilot plants). Admission deadlines are tentative and subject to change based on national level entrance test results.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI), Government of India
caveats: Admission provisions, conditions, and criteria are subject to change by the competent authority without notice
The institute reserves the right to cancel admission of any student on grounds of unsatisfactory academic performance, irregular attendance, or indiscipline
Seat allocation follows GoI reservation norms
Hostel stay is mandatory subject to allotment of accommodation
For tender/EOI applications, EMD and tender fee are mandatory; failure to submit results in rejection
The institute may verify antecedents and documents anytime during service; fake documents may lead to termination and legal action
Any attempt to influence the recruitment or admission process leads to disqualification
The institute may not fill up posts or may cancel/revise recruitment without assigning any reason
For PhD, intake is two students per department with reservation as per GoI rules
For MBA, seats are limited (currently 25) with reservation as per GoI norms
For integrated programmes, details are pending as they are 'Launching Soon'
